scenes.say: Ever freeze when they ask, 'Any questions for us?' Let's make sure you never say 'no.'

scenes.label: Impact
scenes.sub: Good questions show you care about the real job.
scenes.say: Having smart questions ready proves you're thinking about the actual job, not just the offer.
Here are strong questions: What does on-call look like? How much is automated versus manual? What's the biggest technical problem this year? How are changes approved?

scenes.question: When should you ask about salary?
scenes.right: Wait until you have an offer in hand.
scenes.say: Don't ask about salary or benefits yet. Save those for when you actually have an offer.
